general.title: A language partner for a world in motion
general.summary: Langma brings language learning, professional language services, and international pathways together under one roof.
general.intro: A new language can change where you study, who you work with, and how you connect. Langma International supports learners and organisations as they take that next step.
sections: One connected idea
Language is a practical skill and a way into new communities. Our work spans learning, language services, education pathways, and cross-cultural exchange.
Built around your goal
Every conversation starts with what you want to achieve. We help you understand the available options and identify a sensible next step.
Where to begin
Explore courses, language services, international pathways, or get in touch with the team in New Delhi.

general.title: Choose a language. Open a new direction.
general.summary: Explore language programmes and find a course that fits your goals, starting point, and schedule.
general.intro: Search the programme directory by language or region. Course availability and schedules can vary; contact Langma to discuss the option you have in mind.

general.title: Make your study abroad plan feel possible
general.summary: Explore international study options with guidance through research, applications, and preparation for your next step.
general.intro: Choosing where to study involves more than a destination. Start with your subject, academic background, budget, and timeline, then build a plan around options that fit.
sections: Start with your profile
Share your academic history, preferred subject, language skills, budget, and timing. A counsellor can help you understand what to research next.
Compare destinations
Explore study options in Cyprus, Singapore, Mauritius, and other destinations. Programme availability and entry requirements vary by institution.
Plan the application
Organise your documents, application timeline, and questions. Admission and visa decisions are made by the relevant institutions and authorities.

general.title: Study in Cyprus
general.summary: Explore study options in Cyprus and map your next steps with a counsellor.
general.intro: If Cyprus is on your shortlist, begin with your intended programme, academic profile, and budget. The right destination depends on your goals and the current options available.
sections: Explore your fit
Compare available programmes and institutions against your subject interests, entry profile, and timeline.
Build a clear checklist
Ask what documents are needed, when to apply, and which requirements must be confirmed directly with the institution.
Prepare for the move
Plan for the practical steps around travel, accommodation, and arrival using current official guidance.

general.title: Study in Singapore
general.summary: Explore study options in Singapore and plan a route that matches your academic goals.
general.intro: Bring your course interests, academic record, budget, and preferred start date to the first conversation. These details help narrow the research to realistic options.
sections: Compare courses
Review subject areas, institutions, entry criteria, and application timelines before deciding where to apply.
Prepare your application
Create a document checklist and leave time to confirm requirements with each institution.
Plan with current information
Admissions, immigration, and accommodation details can change. Confirm requirements with the relevant institution and authorities.

general.title: Study in Mauritius
general.summary: Explore education options in Mauritius and clarify the steps toward an international study plan.
general.intro: A useful study plan connects your subject choice to the right programme, entry requirements, finances, and timeline. Start by outlining what matters most to you.
sections: Find a suitable programme
Compare course content and entry requirements with your academic background and future plans.
Understand the timeline
Map application dates, document preparation, and the next decisions you will need to make.
Get ready to travel
Confirm current travel, visa, and arrival guidance with official sources before making arrangements.

general.title: Build a more confident route to work abroad
general.summary: Explore international career options and prepare your language and application skills for a global job search.
general.intro: Working abroad starts with a clear picture of your profession, destination, experience, and the requirements that apply to you. Use the first conversation to understand what to verify and where to focus.
sections: Clarify your direction
List the roles, countries, and working conditions you are considering. Requirements differ by profession and destination.
Prepare your profile
Review your CV, interview skills, language needs, and professional documentation.
Check current rules
Work permission and immigration decisions are made by the relevant authorities. Confirm current requirements through official channels.

general.title: Support for the steps around your move
general.summary: Get help organising the practical questions that arise as you plan an international move.
general.intro: An international move can raise many small questions at once. Global Assist brings them into one conversation so you can identify what to handle next.
sections: Make a plan
Discuss your destination, timeline, and the practical support you need to arrange.
Keep the checklist moving
Break the process into manageable tasks and keep key documents and dates organised.
Use trusted information
Always confirm immigration, travel, and legal requirements with the relevant official authorities.

general.title: Explore residency by investment options
general.summary: Discuss residency-by-investment pathways and the questions to research before deciding whether one fits.
general.intro: Investment migration is a significant personal and financial decision. Begin with your objectives and seek current, qualified advice on eligibility, costs, timelines, and risks.
sections: Define your priorities
Consider your family needs, mobility goals, investment horizon, and preferred destinations.
Understand the requirements
Eligibility, minimum investment, due diligence, and processing rules vary by programme and can change.
Get independent advice
Confirm all details with official programme sources and appropriately qualified legal and financial professionals.

general.title: Understand Golden Visa pathways
general.summary: Explore the questions that matter when researching residence programmes commonly called Golden Visas.
general.intro: Residence programmes change over time and differ by country. A careful first step is to compare your goals with the current official requirements and obtain qualified advice.
sections: Compare your objectives
Clarify whether you are researching residence, family mobility, business access, or a longer-term plan.
Check current eligibility
Programme rules, investment thresholds, and benefits vary by country and may change.
Make informed decisions
Verify information with official sources and independent legal and financial advisers before committing funds.

general.title: Learn through cultural exchange
general.summary: Explore programmes that bring people, language, and cultural understanding together.
general.intro: Cultural exchange creates space to learn from people and places directly. Tell us what kind of experience you are looking for and who will take part.
sections: Choose the purpose
Set a goal such as language immersion, cultural learning, professional exchange, or a group visit.
Shape the experience
Discuss participant needs, timing, destination, and the balance of learning and activities.
Prepare together
The details can be planned around your group and confirmed before the programme begins.

general.title: Travel with curiosity
general.summary: Discover cultural travel experiences designed to make language and local context part of the journey.
general.intro: A cultural holiday is a chance to explore a place with more context. Share your interests, preferred pace, and travel window to start a conversation.
sections: Find your theme
Choose the places, traditions, food, arts, or language experiences that interest you most.
Plan for your group
Discuss dates, group size, accessibility, and the style of experience you prefer.
Confirm the details
Travel arrangements and availability should be confirmed directly before booking.

general.title: Create a meaningful business exchange
general.summary: Connect organisations through focused business exchange and cross-cultural collaboration.
general.intro: Successful international collaboration starts with a clear purpose. Define the sectors, partners, and outcomes your organisation hopes to explore.
sections: Set an objective
Identify the markets, industries, or relationships you want the exchange to support.
Bring the right people together
Consider the participants, expertise, and cultural context needed for a useful conversation.
Plan the next step
Shape a programme around the goals and practical constraints of your delegation.

general.title: Plan a business delegation
general.summary: Organise a purposeful delegation with the people, meetings, and context your team needs.
general.intro: A well-planned delegation makes room for preparation as well as the visit itself. Start with your objectives, participants, destination, and available dates.
sections: Define the visit
Set clear goals for the delegation and the kind of organisations or people you hope to meet.
Coordinate the programme
Discuss meeting formats, interpretation or language needs, logistics, and participant priorities.
Follow through
Capture outcomes and next steps so the work can continue after the delegation returns.

general.title: Meet, learn, and connect
general.summary: Explore Langma events and opportunities to connect around languages, education, and global exchange.
general.intro: Events create a place to ask questions and meet people working across languages and international pathways. Contact the team to learn about upcoming opportunities.
sections: Find the right event
Ask about the subject, audience, format, and any registration details for an event you are considering.
Take part
Some events may be online and others in person. Confirm current dates and availability with the organisers.
Stay connected
If there is not an event for your topic yet, share what you would like to see next.

general.title: Mark your progress
general.summary: Learn about course completion certificates and language exam preparation options.
general.intro: The right certificate depends on your course and what you need it for. Ask about programme completion documents or preparation for an external language examination.
sections: Course completion
Ask the team which certificate is associated with your programme and what completion requirements apply.
External examinations
Preparation may be available for selected exams in English, French, German, Japanese, Mandarin, and other languages.
Confirm before applying
Exam providers set their own registration, eligibility, and assessment rules. Confirm details directly with the provider.

general.title: Language support for business
general.summary: Bring language services and cross-cultural communication into your organisation's plans.
general.intro: From multilingual content to communication across markets, the Business Hub is a starting point for organisations with language needs.
sections: Talk through the brief
Describe your audiences, languages, content, formats, and delivery timeline.
Find the right service
Explore translation, localization, transcription, multilingual DTP, proofreading, voiceover, dubbing, and subtitles.
Agree a project plan
The team can discuss scope, deliverables, review steps, and a suitable next conversation.

general.title: Payment information
general.summary: Contact the team to confirm current fees, payment options, and the details for your enrolment.
general.intro: Payment instructions can depend on the programme and your enrolment. Confirm the amount, method, and account details directly with Langma before making a transfer.
sections: Get a confirmed fee
Ask for a written fee breakdown for your selected programme, including any applicable taxes or additional charges.
Confirm the payment route
Use payment instructions provided directly by the team. Verify beneficiary and account details before sending money.
Keep your receipt
Save your payment confirmation and share it with the team if you need help matching it to your enrolment.

general.title: Ideas for your next global step
general.summary: Read about language learning, cultural connection, study abroad, and international careers.
general.intro: Explore themes that help make a global goal more practical, from building language skills to preparing for a new destination.

general.title: Build a career with languages
general.summary: Interested in teaching, language services, counselling, or supporting international programmes? Start a conversation with our team.
general.intro: We welcome people who care about language, learning, and helping others connect across cultures. Send your profile and the kind of work you are interested in.
sections: Teaching and learning
Tell us about the languages you teach, your experience, and the learners you work best with.
Language services
Share your language pairs, subject areas, and relevant translation, editing, or media experience.
Operations and counselling
Describe your experience helping students, clients, or teams plan and complete projects.

general.title: Let’s find your next step
general.summary: Tell us what you are working toward. The Langma team in New Delhi can help you find the right place to begin.
general.intro: Choose a course, ask about a language service, or talk through an international plan. Send a note or contact the team directly.

general.title: Questions, answered
general.summary: Quick answers about course selection, learning formats, enrolment, payment, and certificates.
general.intro: If you cannot find the answer you need, contact the team and ask about your specific programme.

general.title: Cancellation and refund policy
general.summary: Review the current cancellation and refund terms with Langma before enrolling or making a payment.
general.intro: Refund eligibility depends on the programme, timing, and the circumstances of a request. The information on this page is a plain-language overview; request the current written policy from Langma before making an enrolment decision.
sections: Before enrolment
Ask for the current policy, including the process, deadlines, documentation, and any deductions that may apply.
Making a request
Submit a written request with the supporting information requested by the team. Ask for confirmation that the request has been received.
Need clarification?
Contact Langma directly for the current policy that applies to your programme and situation.

general.title: Terms and conditions
general.summary: Read the terms that apply to admission, placement, attendance, assessment, and payment for a Langma programme.
general.intro: These terms cover key parts of the student experience. Please request and review the complete current terms from Langma before enrolling; programme-specific terms may apply.
sections: Admission and placement
Admission may involve an application and a placement assessment. The programme level should be discussed with the team before enrolment.
Attendance and assessment
Ask about induction, timetable, attendance expectations, assessment, and any examination requirements for your course.
Fees and payment
Confirm the full fee, payment method, applicable taxes or charges, and refund terms in writing before payment.
Questions
Contact Langma if you need the current complete terms or an explanation of how they apply to you.

general.title: Privacy notice
general.summary: Learn how to ask about the personal information you share when you contact or enquire with Langma.
general.intro: When you contact Langma, share only information relevant to your enquiry. Ask the team for the current privacy notice and details about how your information is handled.
sections: Enquiry information

Information submitted in an enquiry may be used to respond to your request and discuss relevant services. Do not include sensitive information unless the team asks for it through an appropriate channel.
Cookies and external services
Websites may use cookies, analytics, embedded media, or third-party links. Review the current site privacy notice and your browser controls for details.
Questions or requests
For questions about personal information, contact info@langmainternational.com and describe your request.

general.title: Prepare for IELTS
general.summary: Build English skills and become familiar with the IELTS format as part of a focused preparation plan.
general.intro: Start by identifying your target, test date, and current level. A preparation plan can help you practise the skills and task types relevant to your exam.
sections: Understand your starting point
Discuss your current English level and any previous test experience.
Practise with a purpose
Build listening, reading, writing, and speaking practice into your preparation routine.
Confirm the exam details
Registration, test dates, format, and score requirements are set by the exam provider. Check current details directly.

general.title: Prepare for Goethe exams
general.summary: Prepare for a Goethe-Zertifikat examination with German study organised around your target level.
general.intro: Share the level and exam date you are aiming for. Your plan can combine language development with practice for the exam format.
sections: Confirm your target
Goethe-Zertifikat exams are offered at different levels. Check which level is required for your purpose.
Build the four skills
Plan practice in listening, reading, writing, and speaking alongside your broader German learning.
Check registration
Exam dates, centres, fees, and registration are managed by the provider. Confirm current information with them.

general.title: Prepare for DELF and DALF
general.summary: Work toward a DELF or DALF qualification with French practice matched to your target level.
general.intro: Discuss your current level, intended exam, and timing so your preparation can focus on the right skills and task types.
sections: Choose the right level
DELF and DALF cover different proficiency levels. Confirm the qualification required for your next step.
Practise all skills
Include listening, reading, writing, and speaking practice as you build French confidence.
Verify exam arrangements
Registration and exam arrangements are set by the provider; check current details directly.

general.title: Prepare for the JLPT
general.summary: Prepare for a JLPT level from N5 to N1 with structured Japanese study and exam-focused practice.
general.intro: Begin with your current Japanese level and the JLPT level you have in mind. A plan can balance exam skills with broader language learning.
sections: Select a target
The JLPT has five levels. Check the level that aligns with your learning or professional goal.
Build your study routine
Plan regular practice in vocabulary, grammar, reading, and listening.
Confirm test dates
Registration periods, test locations, and exam arrangements vary. Check the provider's latest information.

general.title: Prepare for HSK
general.summary: Build Mandarin skills and practise toward the HSK level that supports your learning goals.
general.intro: Tell the team your current Mandarin experience and which HSK level you are considering. Your preparation can be planned around that starting point.
sections: Set a clear goal
HSK levels and requirements can change. Confirm the level and format you need with the current exam provider.
Practise progressively
Build vocabulary, listening, reading, and writing skills into a consistent study plan.
Plan registration
Check the current exam dates, fees, and registration requirements directly with the provider.

general.title: Prepare for TestDaF
general.summary: Develop academic German skills and prepare for the TestDaF exam format.
general.intro: TestDaF is often considered by people planning German-language study. Begin by checking the language requirements of your intended institution.
sections: Understand the requirement
Confirm the score or result required by the institution or programme you are applying to.
Practise academic communication
Develop reading, listening, writing, and speaking for academic contexts.
Check current exam details
Test dates, delivery format, and registration are controlled by the provider. Confirm them directly.

general.title: Prepare for TOPIK
general.summary: Build Korean skills and plan study toward the TOPIK level that fits your goals.
general.intro: Discuss your current Korean level, intended TOPIK level, and timeline. This helps create a more focused study plan.
sections: Choose your target
TOPIK has different test levels. Check which result is relevant to your study or professional goal.
Make practice consistent
Include vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, and written practice in your routine.
Confirm the test
Current test dates, locations, and registration details should be checked with the exam provider.
